settings.name: Boarage PDP
settings.paragraph: Design tokens for the Boarage product page sections (boarage-pdp-01 … 14).

use_theme_fonts.label: Use the theme fonts
use_theme_fonts.info: Off: the two fonts below are used (Outfit for headings, Work Sans for text, like the reference page).

base_size.label: Base text size
base_size.info: 18 px is the minimum for the 60+ audience. Headings and spacing scale with it.

color_primary.label: Primary dark (Kelp)
color_primary.info: Headings on light backgrounds, selected card border, badges, check marks, guarantee icon.

color_cta.label: Accent (Dawn)
color_cta.info: The one accent: buttons, stars, sale/guarantee strip. Use it as a fill only, never as text on a light background.

color_mint.label: Highlight on dark backgrounds
color_mint.info: Italic words in headlines, big numbers and icons on the dark Kelp sections.

color_soft.label: Info panels (Mist)
color_soft.info: Selected option cards, FAQ, trust box, chart fill.

color_warm.label: Secondary panels (Oat)
color_warm.info: Benefits box, purchase panel, guarantee box, stage cards, gallery background, saving badges.

color_bg.label: Page background
color_bg.info: Sea Salt by default (the brand never uses pure white). Clear it to keep the theme background.

dark_mode.label: Dark mode
dark_mode.info: "Follow system" honours the visitor's device setting. The theme header and footer have no dark mode.

settings.guarantee_paragraph: Typed once, shown in the buy box and the timeline section (each has an on/off switch).

heading.label: Headline
heading.info: Italic words are highlighted (Dawn Deep on light, Dawn on dark).

show_rating.label: Show the star rating line
show_rating.info: Uses the reviews.rating metafield filled by the reviews app. Nothing shows until it exists.

rating_prefix.label: Text before the rating
rating_prefix.info: Example: “Rated”. Leave empty to show the number only.

show_guarantee.label: Show the guarantee box
show_guarantee.info: Text comes from Theme settings › Boarage PDP › Guarantee box.

settings.paragraph: Dawn guarantee/sale strip with a bold headline, a sub-line and an optional countdown. Hidden while empty.

countdown_mode.label: Countdown
countdown_mode.info: “Daily” restarts at the visitor's midnight. “Until a date” uses the end below and hides itself afterwards.

countdown_end.label: End (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM)
countdown_end.info: Interpreted in the visitor's local time.

settings.paragraph: Gallery with benefit tiles, rating, title, description, benefits, weight cards, subscription / one-time cards, add-to-cart, trust box, guarantee and accordions. Product-only.

seal_1.label: Round seal 1 on the first image
seal_1.info: Two to four short words, e.g. “Made in Germany”.

show_rating.label: Show the star rating line
show_rating.info: Uses the reviews.rating metafield. A reviews app block added to this section replaces it.

settings.purchase_paragraph: Product setup: one option for the dog's weight and one for the supply length (values start with the number of months, e.g. “2-month supply”). Every weight × supply pair is a variant with its own price. The subscription card appears when the product has a selling plan (e.g. Shopify Subscriptions) and uses the weight's 1-month variant.

weight_option.label: Product option for the dog's weight
weight_option.info: The option name, e.g. “Dog weight”. Empty: the first option.

supply_option.label: Product option for the supply length
supply_option.info: The option name, e.g. “Supply”. Empty: the other option.

sub_label.label: Subscription card title
sub_label.info: Empty: the selling plan group name.

supply_badge.label: Saving badge on the supply cards
supply_badge.info: [percent] becomes the saving against buying 1-month supplies, e.g. “Save [percent]%”. Hidden when there is no saving.

cta_label.label: Add-to-cart button label
cta_label.info: Empty: the theme's “Add to cart” text.

cta_show_price.label: Show the price inside the button

show_payment_icons.label: Show payment icons
show_payment_icons.info: The payment methods enabled in the Shopify admin.

sticky_cta_label.label: Sticky bar button label
sticky_cta_label.info: Empty: same as the main button.

tile.name: Gallery tile
tile.paragraph: Dark Kelp tile next to the first image (max. 3).

lead.label: Bold lead word
lead.info: Shown bold before the text, e.g. “Muscles”.

weight.name: Weight card
weight.paragraph: One card per value of the weight option, in option order. The weight sets the dose, so each weight has its own prices.

match.label: Option value to match
match.info: Example: “Up to 20 lb”. Empty: the card follows the block position.

image.label: Round image
image.info: Empty: a paw icon that grows with the weight.

point.name: Subscription point
point.paragraph: Shown under the subscription card while it is selected (max. 3).

settings.paragraph: Tide panel with swipeable review cards. Add the reviews app block or manual reviews.
Questions render as accordion cards and as FAQ structured data for Google.
Dark section: photo, headline, paragraph and a red-marked symptom list.
Tide card on a Kelp section: eyebrow, headline, paragraph, up to four icon items and a product image.
Headline and up to four cards (photo left, text right) describing how the problem progresses.
Eyebrow, headline, paragraph and a schematic two-curve chart (no numbers) or an image.

chart_alt.label: Chart description for screen readers
chart_alt.info: One sentence saying what the two curves show.

settings.paragraph: Tide section: headline, milestones on a rail with checklists, guarantee box.
Five stars, headline and a swipeable strip of customer photos.

show_stars.label: Show five stars above the headline

settings.paragraph: Three columns: us (Kelp, checks), feature, others (Oat, crosses).

sr_yes.label: Screen-reader word for a check
sr_yes.info: Read aloud instead of the icon, e.g. “yes”.

settings.paragraph: Dark card: photo, headline, statistics you enter yourself, product image and the extended guarantee.

value.label: Value
value.info: Example: “94 %”. Use only figures you can back up.

settings.paragraph: Eyebrow, headline, rating line and a list of reviews with a “load more” link; app blocks render below.

more_label.label: “Load more” link text
more_label.info: Empty: all reviews show at once.

settings.paragraph: Dark footer strip: category line, disclaimer notes, ingredients and the mandatory links.
